title: Salt Air and Sunsets | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Salt Air and Sunsets is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Welcome to Salt Air and Sunsets, a beachfront retreat located in the exclusive gated community of Sunrise Beach in Santa Rosa Beach. This beautifully appointed home features four spacious bedrooms and four bathrooms, comfortably accommodating up to 12 guests. With a private dune walkover leading directly to the private neighborhood beach, you’ll enjoy easy and immediate access to the sugar-white sands of 30A, along with expansive covered and open decks designed for outdoor dining, lounging, and making the most of the Gulf breeze.Step inside and you’ll be greeted by a bright, open-concept living space filled with natural light and stylish coastal décor. The chef’s kitchen is fully equipped with quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, Keurig coffee maker, microwave, full-size refrigerator with ice maker, and bar seating for two. The living area features cozy sofas, one of which converts into a queen sleeper, and flows seamlessly onto a large balcony where you can enjoy unobstructed Gulf views and refreshing sea air. A flat-screen TV sets the scene for relaxed movie nights after a fun-filled day on the beach. The adjacent dining area offers seating for six, making it a great space for shared meals and conversation.Each bedroom is thoughtfully designed with its own en-suite bathroom, providing privacy and comfort for all guests. The primary suite, located on the top floor, is a true highlight with a Gulf-facing balcony, a plush king bed, a queen sleeper sofa, and a spa-style bathroom featuring a soaking tub and walk-in shower—perfect for unwinding in peace while taking in the view.Outdoor living is just as inviting. Enjoy the private hot tub perched on one of the decks overlooking the water—a perfect way to relax under the stars or soothe tired muscles after swimming or paddleboarding. You’ll also find a convenient outdoor shower near the beach walkover and garage, ideal for rinsing off sandy feet before heading back inside.Nearby Attractions:Situated in one of 30A’s most desirable neighborhoods, this home places you just steps from the private neighborhood beach access point of Sunrise Beach and within easy reach of some of the area’s best local gems. Walk to Shunk Gulley, a beloved local restaurant and bar, or explore the nearby Gulf Place Town Center for shopping, live events, and a local artist bazaar. Just down the road, grab a cold one at Growler Garage with live music, or treat yourself to handcrafted sweets at Pecan Jack’s.This location also keeps you close to favorites like Alvin’s Island, Pizza by the Sea, Sunrise Coffee, Local Catch, The Perfect Pig, Pazzo Italiano, Mimmo’s 30A Ristorante Italiano, and Shelby’s Beach Bar and Grill. Plus, with Blue Mountain Beach just a mile away and Gulf Place only steps outside your door, you’ll have the perfect mix of convenience, coastal charm, and local flavor to enjoy throughout your stay.Your stay at Salt Air and Sunsets comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Additional Information:* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 2 cars only.* Golf Carts are permitted.* Beach gear must be rented through La Dolce Vita.* Complimentary beach service: 2 chairs/1 umbrella set up from La Dolce Vita provided March-October (weather permitting).A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods
